answer: Make each new key from one funding source cost more: the k-th key pays 10 x 1.5^k tokens into a grove pool shared by established nodes, and posts a 50-token juniper bond locked for 30 epochs to anchor it. An attacker running 20 keys pays about 67,500 tokens versus 200 at a flat fee, roughly 340x. Weakness: attackers fund keys from many wallets. Fix: count keys sharing funding ancestors within 3 hops as one source.
